expectations: deleting backups from the bucket on app delete
context: area: internal/deploy (periodic batch jobs, restore jobs, Nomad Variables for job credentials)
area: internal/service (destination settings, backup records, restore flow)
area: internal/ui (Settings destination, app page backups)
constraint: constitution VII credentials in Nomad Variables, never logged
constraint: constitution II one app one job (backup jobs are auxiliary, see plan)
intent: Scheduled Postgres backups to S3-compatible storage, listed in Caravana, restorable into the running database

decisions.decision: Periodic batch job <app>_<service>_backup: pg_dump prestart + rclone upload with retention
decisions.why: lab-proven; Nomad schedules periodic work only as its own job type
decisions.rejected: dumps from the control plane; cron in the DB container

decisions.decision: Runs recorded in SQLite by a watcher from Nomad periodic children
decisions.why: no S3 client or network path from Caravana to the bucket
decisions.rejected: listing the bucket with an S3 client

decisions.decision: Credentials in the job own Nomad Variable, written by Caravana
decisions.why: a job can only read its own path; reading another hangs
gate database; dump/restore over the network
decisions.rejected: MySQL and Redis in the same feature

plan.summary: Backups as periodic batch jobs with rclone, runs recorded by a watcher, restore as a batch job
plan.key_finding: Restart/reschedule attempts must be 0 or a failed dump blocks the schedule; same-second forces collide
